//: Powers made of areas (08 §7.2): a bubble of still time, a null field, a gravity well, floating and a shadow. Each is an area, a clock, an ambient override, a light or a suppression, bound to the ability that made it (08 §7.3); none is an engine feature. Nobody has them by default; the template and the trait `power_sampler` give them. Values are illustrative.
Worn while time stands still round its maker, who goes on at the realm's pace.
name: Outside time

//: Stopping time round oneself (08 §9.1): the maker's own clock is pinned to the realm's, and an area round them whose clock runs at a thousandth of the realm's follows them. Everyone and everything it comes over all but stops: people mid-step, bodies in flight, fire. It drains the reserve while it lasts; when the mode ends, by choice or an empty reserve, the bubble goes and everything inside goes on from where it was.
name: Time stop
description: Time all but stops round you while you go on. It drains your reserve.

//: Inside one, every ability tagged `power` is suppressed (08 §6.2).

A field round its maker in which powers fail: whoever it comes over loses what their powers confer and their modes end; leaving it, their powers return and their modes do not. Its maker's own powers resist their own field, by a rule on the hook `ability_suppressing`. It is not itself a `power`, so it is not suppressed by another's field.
name: Null field
description: Powers fail near you, except your own.

//: Six times the ground's pull: a stability check is asked for what stands inside, so that what does not bear the weight gives way, and bodies in flight inside come down six times as hard.
A well of crushing gravity laid at a cell for a while, bound to the ability that made it.
name: Gravity well
Gravity well
description: Gravity six times as strong over a place, for a while: what cannot bear it gives way, and what falls there falls hard.

//: No gravity in its maker's own cell, wherever they go: thrown, they fly straight and do not come down.
name: Float
description: Nothing pulls you down while you float. It drains your reserve slowly.

//: Worn while a shadow clings to its maker.
name: Shrouded

//: A darkness that goes where its maker goes: a light of negative intensity at the middle of an area anchored to them. Light never goes below none, so it puts out what light there is and no more.
name: Shadow
description: Darkness gathers round you and follows you.
